violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil * was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. . Countertop between the 3 compartment sink and the prep sink is damaged and in need of repair. The laminate top is damaged and allows for water to seep under into the wood grain making it uncleanable.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling * were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. . Floor drain is damaged and not sealed. Requires repairs.
